name: NodeGoat A01 - Mass assignment via req.body

expectedVulnerabilities.description: Mass assignment allows clients to overwrite privileged fields (isAdmin, role).

expectedFix: Allowlist the fields copied from req.body before calling UserDAO.update.

name: NodeGoat A03 - SQL injection via string concatenation

expectedVulnerabilities.description: User input concatenated into SQL string without parameterisation.

expectedFix: Use parameterized queries: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?', [userInput]).

name: NodeGoat A03 - Reflected XSS in profile response

expectedVulnerabilities.description: Unescaped query parameter rendered into HTML response.

expectedFix: Encode 'name' before interpolation, e.g. via a templating engine with auto-escaping.

name: NodeGoat A08 - Insecure deserialisation via eval

expectedVulnerabilities.description: eval() on user-supplied data permits arbitrary code execution.

expectedFix: Replace eval with JSON.parse and validate the parsed object against a schema.

name: NodeGoat A02 - Weak hashing for password storage

expectedVulnerabilities.description: MD5 is not collision-resistant and is unsuitable for password hashing.

expectedFix: Use bcrypt, scrypt, or argon2 with a per-user salt.

name: Juice Shop - Broken access control on admin endpoint

expectedVulnerabilities.description: Admin endpoint exposed without role check.

expectedFix: Add a middleware verifying req.user.role === 'admin' before responding.

name: Juice Shop - Path traversal in file download

expectedVulnerabilities.description: User-controlled filename joined into a filesystem path without containment.

expectedFix: Resolve the joined path and assert it stays inside __dirname/uploads, e.g. via path.resolve and startsWith check.

name: Juice Shop - JWT 'none' algorithm acceptance

expectedVulnerabilities.description: jwt.verify without algorithms option accepts forged 'none'-algorithm tokens.

expectedFix: Pass algorithms: ['HS256'] (or the pinned algorithm) to jwt.verify.

name: CVE-2022-24999 - Express qs prototype pollution

expectedVulnerabilities.description: qs <6.10.3 parses __proto__ keys; Object.assign propagates the pollution.

expectedFix: Upgrade qs to >=6.10.3 and switch to Object.assign(Object.create(null), opts).

name: CVE-2021-23337 - Lodash _.template code injection

expectedVulnerabilities.description: Lodash <4.17.21 compiles user-controlled templates into JS code.

expectedFix: Upgrade lodash to >=4.17.21 and never pass attacker-controlled strings to _.template.

name: CVE-2022-24771 - node-forge digest signature confusion

expectedVulnerabilities.description: node-forge <1.3.0 mishandles DigestInfo, enabling RSA signature forgery.
